_comment: Example only. Your real profiles live outside this repository, at
and folder paths. Create them with `ssdaudit pick` rather than by hand.
Drives are identified by volume serial, never by letter -- run
`ssdaudit volumes` to see the serials of your attached drives. This is what
keeps a profile pointing at the right disk after Windows reassigns letters.
`fallback_path` is only used when the serial cannot be resolved, e.g. when
comparing two folders on a single drive.
